scene: You cross the creaky footbridge to the high transit junction.
picture: Flat side view along the wooden transit platform. On the far left waits a yellow bicycle rickshaw with a cap-wearing driver. Centre stands a brass spiral staircase lift cage with an open gate. The player stands between them facing right. On the far right hangs a striped open gondola of a giant ferris wheel.
shown: A yellow bicycle rickshaw with an idle driver waiting on the far left. Below. Along the deck.
A brass spiral staircase lift with open sliding gates in the centre.
A striped ferris wheel gondola hanging open at a platform on the far right.

variants.scene: Cool evening air greets you on the high wooden platform above the city.
Sunset glows as you hum {tune} beside the tall spiral elevator tower.
You reach the bustling skywalk between the rickshaw and the giant wheel.
